coordinates: origin top-left, x right, y down
objective: Investigate how temperature affects lipase digestion of fat in milk.
word_equation: milk fat + water —(lipase)→ fatty acids + glycerol

graph_axes.y: time for pink colour to disappear / s

guidance: The pink milk mixture and lipase are equilibrated at 20 °C in the electric water bath. Add the lipase to start the timer.

electric_water_bath.water_appearance: clearly visible cyan volume with a bright meniscus and animated surface ripples
electric_water_bath.submerged_interior: white enamel visible beneath the water

lipase_temperature_practical.endpoint: pink phenolphthalein becomes colourless as fatty acids lower pH
